channel.title: Sahaj's blog
channel.description: Study notes, AI updates and paper summaries by Sahaj Saliya.

item.title: Paper summary: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
item.description: Lin et al. introduce FrameForge, a framework leveraging pretrained video foundation models for unified conditional image generation via input-adaptive virtual temporal relations and latent intermediate reasoning.

item.title: Paper summary: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
item.description: Cho et al. propose LOWN, a training-free decoding strategy for diffusion vision-language models that adaptively determines when to process visual tokens, preserving 99.6% performance while slashing decoding FLOPs to 35.3%.

item.title: Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk"): ~1T-parameter MoE with sparse attention
item.description: Mistral Large 4 is a multimodal MoE of about 1T total parameters with a 1M-token context, combining expert sparsity with sparse attention and a Pixtral vision encoder, released in FP8 and NVFP4 under an MIT-derived open-weight licence.

item.title: Agentic AI & MCP Systems · The Future of Agentic AI: Autonomous Software Engineers, Enterprise Workflow Automation, and Collaborative Multi-Agent Ecosystems
item.description: An exhaustive technical deep-dive into The Future of Agentic AI (Autonomous Software Engineers, Enterprise Workflow Automation, and Collaborative Multi-Agent Ecosystems): architectural mechanics, foundational theory, formal derivations, and runnable verified implementations.

item.title: Paper summary: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
item.description: Training a spatial VLM on one kind of answer (e.g. left/right) doesn't teach related ones (e.g. distance), which the authors call "interface lock-in"; ChronoReplay replays mixed spatial supervision as time-ordered episodes and improves three streaming benchmarks together.
